title_en: Apartment for Sale - Jordan Misja Street
description_en: Apartment for Sale - Rruga Jordan Misja Perfect location In one of the most developed and accessible areas of Tirana, right next to the New Ring Road and with quick access to the center, Kombinat, and Zogun e Zi. 300 m near the small ring road. New building construction to be completed February - March 2026. Total area: 71.66 m² Located on the 1st floor of a new building with elevator and contemporary construction standards. Organization: 1 Living room + kitchen area 1 Bedroom 1 Toilet 1 Balcony Distribution corridor Possibility of bank credit. The apartment is very bright, south-west orientation, with functional and maximally usable partitions.
